title: unique netherite
description: makes the netherite uniquely styled and colored for mods that look just like recolored netherite. farmers delight support.
body: used a mod like cjs enderite and dont want it to look so close to netherite? if so this retextures netherite to look much better in my opinion. if you want a unique helmet design with the same netherite colors try this[click](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mandalorian-helmets)
